about.title: About CraftHub
about.description1: CraftHub is a platform specializing in traditional Chinese handicrafts. We are committed to providing craft enthusiasts with quality handmade items, including sandalwood prayer beads, natural incense, wooden carvings, purple clay tea sets and more.
about.description2: Each piece is carefully selected to ensure its craftsmanship quality and cultural significance. Through this platform, we hope to introduce more people to the charm of traditional handicrafts and experience the spirit of artisan mastery.

heritage.title: Millennial Craftsmanship Heritage
heritage.description: We focus on collecting and showcasing exquisite traditional Chinese handicrafts. From warm sandalwood prayer beads to elegant natural incense, from intricate wood carvings to rustic purple clay tea sets, each piece embodies profound cultural heritage and artisan spirit.
